analysis:
This PR adds a local add-on hold. A new Unix-socket IPC lets a signed add-on (io.darkbloom.sandbox) close provider admission, drain work and unload models.

Peer authentication (AddonPeerPolicy.swift:57-80):
- Requires the same euid.
- Takes the kernel audit token from LOCAL_PEERTOKEN (lines 83-89), not a peer-supplied PID or path.
- Resolves the running code with SecCodeCopyGuestWithAttributes(audit).
- Checks the Developer ID requirement plus the team ID, identifier and hardened-runtime flag.
- The development identity is read only under #if DEBUG (lines 37-39, 43-53).

Hold handling (ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift):
- Line 67 binds the claimed add-on to the verified signer.
- ownedHold (lines 115-119) scopes status, renew and release to that identifier.
- The operator path (lines 121-150) uses LifecycleMailbox identity validation.
- Line 160 refuses a new hold while a lifecycle stop or model switch owns the drain.
- leaveAddonHold (line 217) reopens admission only if the add-on hold still owns the drain.
- Line 251 cancels in-flight work after 120 s. This is an availability effect controlled by the local operator or add-on, which TB-003 already places within operator capability. It does not expose plaintext (A-001).

App Attest, receipts and authorization:
- The hold does not touch the App Attest worker or the drain barrier.
- Grant, revocation and endpoint binding (T-053, TB-011) are unchanged in this batch.

Wire changes (CoordinatorClient+Registration.swift:46, 128, 147):
- Registration and heartbeat now carry an optional `busy` field containing the add-on identifier and sinceMs.
- Heartbeat sends `busy` only alongside status=draining.
- This is minor new metadata to the trusted coordinator, not a confidentiality regression.

AutopilotBusy.swift:15-16 adds the addonHold busy reason; this is a benign refactor.

Open questions for integration (source not supplied):
- AddonIPCServer: socket creation, file permissions, symlink/unlink safety, frame size limits and per-connection DoS bounds.
- AddonHoldPaths.production() and the AddonHoldStore/AddonMachineLock file handling (TOCTOU, symlink following).
- The CoordinatorClientCodec body: busy-field encoding.
- resumeAfterAddonHold and beginServingDrain semantics.
- Whether the coordinator honors draining or busy without granting trust. This is platform-owned.

The threat model has no boundary covering the add-on IPC, so TB-003 may need an update to document it.
